posts.title: exam season blog #ultimo
posts.description: On the way to my second exam, I am frantically flipping over my notes; as I disembark, a man on the train wishes me good luck with my studies. "I'll need it," I think. On the bus to university, a backpacker swaps sides to avoid the glare of the sun. He leaves a small coin - maybe a euro - on his seat, and I point it out. posts.title: exam season blog #3
posts.description: T-minus 4.5 hours until exam #2. This is, as aforementioned, the "harder" of my two theory examinations. And it certainly feels like it! One thing I've noticed, though, is that even though I haven't properly reviewed everything yet ( eeeyikes!!! ), whenever I do encounter an "unfamiliar" thing, it's not entirely unfamiliar. As in, with histology, it was like "DAMN! what the FUCK is a glucosamine!"
